paragraphs: R' Yose of Kfar Hanan. Mentioned in Zohar, Lekh Lekha 86b.[^1][^2]

notes.text: לך is expanded as Lekh Lekha, and פו: as 86b under the colon convention. No Zohar edition is named or independently checked.
דכפר חנן means “of Kfar Hanan.” This notice does not independently identify the person with another Yose; the abbreviated title remains R'.
